tips.title: Define CAM-Part in InventorCAM
tips.body: Create a new CAM-Part manually by selecting 'New' and choosing 'Turning'. Turn off automatic settings for CAM-Part creation, CNC-Machine definition, Stock model definition, and Target model definition.

tips.title: Select CNC-Machine Controller
tips.body: Choose the appropriate CNC-machine controller from the list in the CAM-Part definition process.

tips.title: Define Coordinate System
tips.body: Use the 'Select face' method to define a precise Coordinate System by selecting a model face that remains associative with the model.

tips.title: Define Stock Model
tips.body: Select the 'Cylinder' or 'Box' option to define the boundaries of the stock material used for machining.

tips.title: Define Stock boundary using 3D Model
tips.body: Select the 3D Model of the stock, and InventorCAM will automatically generate a sketch containing the envelope of the selected solid body.

tips.title: Set offsets for Stock boundary
tips.body: Define +Z to 2 and -Z to 25 for front and back offsets from the model.

tips.title: Define Target model for CAM-Part
tips.body: Create an Envelope sketch in the CAM component of the CAM-Part assembly to define the geometry automatically generated by the Envelope function.

tips.title: Set Facet tolerance for model accuracy
tips.body: Set the Facet tolerance to 0.01 for accurate triangulation of stock, target models, and fixtures.

tips.title: Save the CAM-Part data
tips.body: Click to save the defined CAM-Part, and close the dialog box.

tips.title: Define Machine Coordinate System
tips.body: Click the Coordsys button to define the Machine Coordinate System, selecting a face or using other methods like associating with model faces.

tips.title: Select model face for Coordinate System origin
tips.body: Ensure Select face is clicked and Center of revolution face option is chosen to place the origin on the axis of revolution face.

tips.title: Set CoordSys origin on front face
tips.body: Click Change if CoordSys origin is not on the front face of the model.

tips.title: Define CoordSys data
tips.body: Set MAC Number, Position (X, Y, Z), and define levels like Tool start level, Clearance level, Part upper level, Part lower level.

tips.title: Create planar surface at Part Lower level
tips.body: Enable the Create planar surface at Part Lower level option to generate a transparent planar surface.

tips.title: Define Target model
tips.body: Select the target model as the final shape of the CAM-Part after machining.

tips.title: Save the CAM-Part
tips.body: Click Save to close the CAM-Part and save the defined CAM-Part in the InventorCAM Manager tree.

tips.title: Close the CAM-Part
tips.body: Right-click the CAM-Part header in the InventorCAM Manager tree and choose Close to close the CAM-Part.

tips.title: Machine Preview window
tips.body: The Machine Preview window allows you to visualize the schematic position of machine devices without entering Machine Simulation mode.

tips.title: Show/Hide STLs Machine button
tips.body: Toggle between showing and hiding the machine scheme represented by STL files.

tips.title: Update Machine button
tips.body: Updates the machine parameters in the graphic area.

tips.title: Update Stock button
tips.body: Updates the stock parameters in the graphic area.

tips.title: Update Fixtures button
tips.body: Updates the fixture parameters in the graphic area.

tips.title: Update Tools button
tips.body: Updates the tool parameters in the graphic area.

tips.title: Show/Hide Stock button
tips.body: Toggle between showing and hiding the stock model.

tips.title: Show/Hide Target button
tips.body: Toggle between showing and hiding the target model.

tips.title: Focus Target button
tips.body: Focus only on the target model.

tips.title: Focus Tool button
tips.body: Set the current view focused on the tool.

tips.title: Show/Hide MAC CoordSys button
tips.body: Toggle between showing and hiding Coordinate Systems of machine devices and tools.

tips.title: Show/Hide POS CoordSys button
tips.body: Toggle between showing and hiding Coordinate Systems respective to station/positions.

tips.title: Show/Hide Text button
tips.body: Toggle between showing and hiding the names of machine devices.

tips.title: Show/Hide All Tools button
tips.body: Toggle between showing and hiding the tools mounted on turrets.

tips.title: Browse and edit positions of each particular machine axis
tips.body: Edit the value in the edit box or change it gradually by scrolling the mouse wheel.

tips.title: Home Reference Axes button
tips.body: Set axes to Home Reference values.

tips.title: Set All Axes to Zero button
tips.body: Set all axes values to 0 regardless of their original value.

tips.title: Return to Initial Axes Value button
tips.body: Reset all axes values to the original value defined in VMID.

tips.title: Paste Axes Values button
tips.body: Paste current position values into specified edit boxes.

tips.title: Use Add Axes Values button for precise machine positioning
tips.body: Enables adding new rows in MCO operations and pasting current position values into edit boxes.

tips.title: Define Turning operations for various profiles
tips.body: InventorCAM supports Face Turning, Turning, Sim. tilted turning, Cutoff, Manual Turning, Balanced Rough, Trochoidal Turning, Threading, Grooving, Drilling, and Angled Grooving.

tips.title: Drilling operation requires start and end positions
tips.body: For drilling, only define the drill start and end positions without geometry.

tips.title: Sim. tilted turning for curve-shaped tool paths
tips.body: Use Sim. tilted turning for machining of curve-shaped tool paths using tilting capabilities.

tips.title: Define machine setup for Turning operations
tips.body: Use Machine Setup to define relations between fixtures, submachines, and the Machine Coordinate System.

tips.title: Add a Turning Operation in InventorCAM Manager
tips.body: Right-click Operations header and choose Turning from the Add Turning Operation submenu.

tips.title: Define geometry for Turning operations
tips.body: Select wireframe or solid model entities to define turning geometry.

tips.title: Use Envelope sketch for external roughing operations
tips.body: For external roughing, use the Envelope sketch automatically generated in Target model definition.

tips.title: Select default Curve mode in InventorCAM
tips.body: Ensure Curve mode is selected and uncheck Up to Entity, Tangent propagation, and Constant Z Propagation.

tips.title: Define geometry chain for external roughing operation
tips.body: Use the Add Selected Element button to add entities to the chain and define direction with the Change Direction button.

tips.title: Modify geometry for turning operations
tips.body: Use the Modify Geometry button to extend/trim geometries and assign offsets.

tips.title: Define tool for turning operations
tips.body: Select the Ext. Rough tool from the Turning Tools icon and set parameters like Spin normal and finish.

tips.title: Set technological parameters for turning operations
tips.body: Choose the default option in Mode and select Rough or Copy work type based on machining needs.

tips.title: Configure roughing parameters for turning operations
tips.body: Set Step down value to 2 and choose ZX-ABS option in the Rough offset section.

tips.title: Calculate and simulate tool path for turning operations
tips.body: Click the Calculate button to save and calculate the tool path, then use Simulation to check the generated path.

tips.title: Define geometry for face turning operation
tips.body: Select the sketch segment as shown to define the geometry directed towards the rotation axis.

tips.title: Modify geometry for face turning operation
tips.body: Set Start Extension/trimming to 4 and End extension/trimming to 20 in the Modify Geometry dialog box.

tips.title: Define tool for face turning operation
tips.body: Use the same Ext. Rough tool from the previous operation and customize parameters like Spin and Feed.

tips.title: Configure technological parameters for face turning operation
tips.body: Select the Rough option and set Offset Z value to 0.1, then select Finish for finishing pass.

tips.title: Calculate and simulate tool path for face turning operation
tips.body: Click the Calculate button to save and calculate the tool path, then use Simulation to check the generated path.

tips.title: Add drilling operation for internal faces
tips.body: Right-click the Face Turning operation and choose Drilling to add a new drilling operation.

tips.title: Define tool for drilling operation
tips.body: Select the DRILL tool and set parameters like D, A, AD, TL, and OHL.

tips.title: Set SL parameter
Set CL parameter
Define drilling start position
tips.body: Click on the front face of the part

tips.title: Define drilling end position
tips.body: Click on the back face of the part

tips.title: Set cutter tip option for depth type
tips.body: Select the Cutter tip option in the Depth type section

tips.title: Define turning operation template
tips.body: Choose the first turning operation as a template for the current operation

tips.title: Define tool for turning operation
tips.body: Choose the Ext. Rough tool and set parameters as shown in the image

tips.title: Define tool for internal turning operation
tips.body: Choose the Int. Rough tool and set parameters as shown in the image

tips.title: Define tool for external grooving operation
tips.body: Add an Ext. Grooving tool and set parameters as shown in the image

tips.title: Set safety angle for turning operations
tips.body: The parameter defines the angle between the material and the cutting edge of the tool, preventing the cutting edge from coinciding with the material.

tips.title: Define rough grooving parameters
tips.body: Set the Distance value to 0.2 and Step over Value to 2.8 in the Rough tab

tips.title: Define finish grooving parameters
tips.body: Set the Finish value to 0 in the Delta compensation area of the Groove parameters tab

tips.title: Set roughing retreat distance
tips.body: Enter the distance the tool should retreat before moving sideways in the roughing operation.

tips.title: Set finishing retreat distance
tips.body: Enter the distance the tool should retreat before moving sideways in the finishing operation.

tips.title: Simulate tool path in Turning mode
tips.body: Click the Simulation icon to simulate the tool path in the Turning mode.

tips.title: Simulate tool path in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Click the Simulation icon to simulate the tool path in the SolidVerify mode.

tips.title: Define geometry for internal grooving
tips.body: Select sketch segments and ensure Up to Entity, Tangent propagation, and Constant Z Propagation are unselected.

tips.title: Define geometry for angled grooving
tips.body: Select sketch segments and ensure Up to Entity, Tangent propagation, and Constant Z Propagation are unselected.

tips.title: Define geometry for external threading
tips.body: Select sketch segments and ensure the direction is in the negative direction of the Z-axis.

tips.title: Define geometry for internal threading
tips.body: Select sketch segments and ensure the direction is in the negative direction of the Z-axis.

tips.title: Set external finish for internal threading
tips.body: Choose Yes under External finish to perform the finishing pass on the tips of the threads.

tips.title: Set thread finish for internal threading
tips.body: Choose Yes under Thread finish to perform the finishing pass on the thread.

tips.title: Set external finish for external threading
tips.body: Choose Yes under External finish to perform the finishing pass on the tips of the threads.

tips.title: Set thread finish for external threading
tips.body: Choose Yes under Thread finish to perform the finishing pass on the thread.

tips.title: Set step down for internal threading
tips.body: Set Step down to 0.1.

tips.title: Set pitch for internal threading
tips.body: In the Pitch unit area, set the Value to 1.5.

tips.title: Set step down for external threading
tips.body: In the Pitch unit area, set the Value to 1.5.

tips.title: Set pitch for external threading
tips.body: In the Pitch unit area, set the Value to 1.5.

tips.title: Select sketch segment for turning operation
tips.body: Choose a sketch segment directed to the model rotation axis.

tips.title: Set technological parameters for parting operation
tips.body: Choose the Left option in Tool side and Chamfer option in Corner section.

tips.title: Save and calculate tool path for turning operation
tips.body: Click Save and Calculate to save the operation data and calculate the tool path.

tips.title: Simulate tool path for turning operations
tips.body: Simulate the tool path in Turning and SolidVerify modes.

tips.title: Define CAM-Part for machining operations
tips.body: Define the CAM-Part, CNC-controller, Machine Coordinate System, Stock model, Clamp, and Target model.

tips.title: Perform external roughing for machining operations
tips.body: Define a Turning operation to perform the rough machining of the part.

tips.title: Perform external finish for machining operations
tips.body: Perform the finishing of the front faces of the part.

tips.title: Perform internal finish for machining operations
tips.body: Perform the internal finish of the center hole including chamfers.

tips.title: Define drilling operation for machining operations
tips.body: Drill the preliminary hole that will be finally turned at the next stage.

tips.title: Define grooving operation for machining operations
tips.body: Define a Grooving operation to machine three grooves.

tips.title: Define cutoff operation for machining operations
tips.body: Define a Cutoff operation for cutting off the part and machining of the chamfer.

tips.title: Define center drilling for machining operations
tips.body: Define a Drilling operation to perform the preliminary center drilling of the center hole.

tips.title: Define internal turning for machining operations
tips.body: Define a Turning operation to machine the internal model faces.

tips.title: Define back side grooving for machining operations
tips.body: Define a Grooving operation to machine the back faces as shown.

tips.title: Define advanced turning for rest material
tips.body: InventorCAM automatically recognizes and machines Rest Material areas left unmachined after previous operations.

tips.title: Simulate rest material machining
tips.body: Simulate the tool path to see areas left unmachined due to tool reach limitations.

tips.title: Use Rest material option for additional machining
tips.body: In the previous external roughing operation, use the Left orientation moving in negative Z-direction. For Rest material roughing, move in positive Z-direction with Right orientation.

tips.title: Set Mounting on Station for finishing operation

tips.body: Choose a tool with the appropriate parameters and ensure it is set for finish machining.

tips.title: Define tool for facial rough turning
tips.body: Edit the following tool parameters: height (D) to 80, left side of turret with reference to tip point (E) to -15, tool tip angle (a°) to 35°, cutting edges (D1, D2) to 6.

tips.title: Perform facial Rest material machining
tips.body: Use a grooving tool and define an external grooving tool with appropriate parameters.

tips.title: Define tool for facial Rest material machining

tips.title: Define drilling operation for hole machining
tips.body: Sketch a line to define start and end points for drilling, then create a new Drilling operation.
tips.category: toolpath | workholding | safety | tool_selection | strategy | post_processor | machine_setup | troubleshooting | dfm | feature | gcode | other

tips.title: Define U-drill tool for hole machining
tips.body: Use a tool of Ø40 and define the Drill start and end at the endpoints of the line.
tips.category: tool_selection | strategy | post_processor | machine_setup | troubleshooting | dfm | feature | gcode | other

tips.title: Simulate tool path for hole machining
tips.body: InventorCAM automatically determines the Rest material area suitable for machining with the defined tool and technological parameters.
tips.category: simulation | post_processor | machine_setup | troubleshooting | dfm | feature | gcode | other

tips.title: Define partial machining for long turning parts
tips.body: Enable the Partial machining check box in the Geometry page and define the geometry segment to be machined.
tips.category: toolpath | workholding | safety | tool_selection | strategy | post_processor | machine_setup | troubleshooting | dfm | feature | gcode | other

tips.title: Define approach and retreat parameters for partial machining
tips.body: Set the Radius and Line length parameters for the approach/retreat arcs tangential to the profile.
tips.category: toolpath | workholding | safety | tool_selection | strategy | post_processor | machine_setup | troubleshooting | dfm | feature | gcode | other

tips.title: Simulate tool path for partial machining
tips.body: InventorCAM automatically generates the approach and retreat passes at the First point and Second point.
tips.category: simulation | post_processor | machine_setup | troubleshooting | dfm | feature | gcode | other

tips.title: Define approach line for external rough tools
tips.body: When the approach/retreat lines are inside the Material boundary, InventorCAM automatically extends them till the Material boundary.
tips.category: toolpath | workholding | safety | tool_selection | strategy | post_processor | machine_setup | troubleshooting | dfm | feature | gcode | other

tips.title: Modify point to avoid collision
tips.body: Automatically modifies First and Second points based on geometry to avoid collisions during approach and retreat movements.

tips.title: Modify contour to avoid collision
tips.body: Enables modification of partial machining geometry according to tool shape to avoid collisions between the tool and the geometry.

tips.title: Define Partial Machining parameters
tips.body: Set the Distance along axis value for the First and Second points to define overlap between segments.

tips.title: Machine the second segment of geometry
tips.body: Add a new Turning Operation with same geometry and tool data as previous, define Partial machining parameters for overlap.

tips.title: Machine the third segment of geometry
tips.body: Add a new Turning Operation with same parameters as previous, define Partial machining parameters for overlap.

tips.title: Machine the rest of the geometry
tips.body: Continue adding Turning Operations with same parameters and define Partial machining parameters for overlap.

tips.title: Define machine setup and clamping fixture
tips.body: Set up Machine Setup with two Tables, Main_SP and Back_SP, and add Collect Chuck to the fixture.

tips.title: Define workholding parameters for Collect Chuck
tips.body: Set Clamping Dimension and J-Axis value, select Shape type as 3D Model, and configure Part Mounting with Jaw.

tips.title: Define Face turning operation
tips.body: Select Wireframe option for geometry, define machining geometry using Envelope sketch, and extend geometry outside machining area.

tips.title: Set safety distance for rapid tool movement
tips.body: Use default Safety distance value (2). This ensures the tool does not drop into material during rapid movements.

tips.title: Define face turning operation mode
tips.body: Choose 'Face Turning' option in the Mode area to perform operations with the principal working direction along the X-axis.

tips.title: Simulate operation in Host CAD mode
tips.body: Click 'Host CAD Simulation' to display the tool path directly on the model in Autodesk Inventor, allowing viewing from different perspectives.

tips.title: Simulate operation in Turning mode
tips.body: Switch to 'Turning' page on Simulation control panel to display the section view simulation of the turning tool path.

tips.title: Simulate operation in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Switch to 'SolidVerify' page on Simulation control panel to display the simulation of machining on the solid model, using a 3D Stock model with clamping fixture.

tips.title: Extend geometry for tool approach and retreat
tips.body: On the Geometry page, click 'Modify Geometry' to extend the geometry by setting Distance values in Start Extension/trimming and End Extension/trimming sections.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for rough turning
tips.body: Switch to the Technology page, choose 'Rough' work type and 'Longitudinal Turning' mode. Set Step down to 1 and offset from geometry.

tips.title: Define non-descending motions for rough turning
tips.body: Switch to Strategies tab and select 'Non-descending motions' option to leave the groove unmachined.

tips.title: Define geometry for external grooving
tips.body: Select 'Wireframe' option in the Geometry section and create a chain by selecting first and last chain entities.

tips.title: Define tool for external grooving
tips.body: Select 'Ext. Grooving' tool from the Tool page, set X, Y, Z values as 0, 25, and 0.225 respectively.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for external grooving
tips.body: Switch to the Technology page, choose 'External Grooving' mode and set Rough and Semi-finish/Finish parameters.

tips.title: Calculate operation for turning and grooving
tips.body: Click 'Calculate' in the Turning or Grooving Operation dialog box to save data and calculate tool path.

tips.title: Use face mill tools for large flat surfaces
tips.body: Face Milling Operation is designed to machine large flat surfaces with face mill tools.

tips.title: Profile milling can use tool radius compensation
tips.body: In profile milling, you can optionally use tool radius compensation to the right or left side of the geometry.

tips.title: Pocket milling removes material from the interior of a closed geometry
tips.body: Pocket Operation in pocket milling removes material from the interior of a closed geometry.

tips.title: Multi-depth drilling allows feed rate changes
tips.body: Multi-depth Drilling Operation enables you to define manually the areas where the feed rate changes.

tips.title: Thread milling generates helical tool paths for internal and external threads
tips.body: Thread Milling Operation enables you to generate a helical tool path for the machining of internal and external threads with thread mills.

tips.title: Slot operation can define slots with constant or variable depth
tips.body: Slot Operation generates a tool path along the centerline to the right or left of one or more profiles.

tips.title: T-Slot operation machines slots in vertical walls with a slot mill tool
tips.body: T-Slot Operation enables you to machine slots in vertical walls with a slot mill tool.

tips.title: Translated Surface operation generates a surface by moving a section along a profile geometry
tips.body: Translated Surface Operation generates a surface by moving a section along a profile geometry.

tips.title: ToolBox Cycles provide specific machining strategies for different cases
tips.body: ToolBox sub-operations are a set of 2.5D Milling operations, each intended for a specific machining case.

tips.title: Engraving operations can mill text or profiles on a 2D or 3D geometry
tips.body: Engraving Operations allows you to mill text or any other profile on a 2D or 3D geometry.

tips.title: Pocket Recognition Operation recognizes pocket features on the solid model
tips.body: Pocket Recognition Operation enables you to recognize the pocket features on the solid model and perform machining of these features.

tips.title: Edge Deburring Recognition Operation creates necessary machining for chamfer features
tips.body: Edge Deburring Recognition Operation recognizes automatically chamfer features at the target model and creates the necessary machining.

tips.title: Drill Recognition Operation performs powerful drill feature recognition and automatic Drill geometry creation
tips.body: Drill Recognition Operation performs powerful drill feature recognition and automatic Drill geometry creation using the AFRM module functionality.

tips.title: HSS Module provides high-speed surface machining for localized areas
tips.body: InventorCAM HSS module is a high speed surface machining module for smooth and powerful machining of localized surface areas in the part, including undercuts.

tips.title: Turbo 3D HSR/HSM module offers unique machining and linking strategies
tips.body: InventorCAM Turbo 3D HSR/HSM module is a very powerful HSR/HSM module for quick and faster calculations than the normal HSR/HSM module.

tips.title: 3D HSR/HSM module smooths paths to maintain continuous machine tool motion
tips.body: InventorCAM HSR/HSM module smooths the paths of both cutting moves and retracts wherever possible to maintain a continuous machine tool motion.

tips.title: Undercut Milling is useful for machining steep areas of a component
tips.body: Constant Z Undercut Milling is a very powerful module for machining 3D components with tool path passes that are parallel to a plane depending on the machining direction.

tips.title: Sim. 5 Axis Operation enables simultaneous 5-axis machining
tips.body: This operation enables you to perform simultaneous 5-axis machining.

tips.title: Auto 3+2 Roughing Operation detects and processes undercut areas
tips.body: This operation enables you to handle separate sets of Milling levels for each drill position.

tips.title: Rotary Machining Operation generates tool paths for cylindrical parts
tips.body: This operation is designed to generate rotary tool path to mill parts on a 4-axis machine.

tips.title: 3 to 5 axis Conversion allows machining of 3D parts using 5-axis capabilities
tips.body: In some machining cases, there is a need to perform machining of 3D parts using the 5-axis capabilities.

tips.title: Contour 5-Axis Machining Operation generates tool paths for deburring and trimming
tips.body: This machining strategy tilts the tool along a chained 3D profile drive curve, while aligning the tool axis according to defined tilt lines.

tips.title: Multiaxis Drilling Operation machines a series of drills with different orientations
tips.body: This operation enables you to machine a series of drills that have different orientations.

tips.title: SWARF Machining Operation uses the whole flute length of the tool
tips.body: The purpose of the operation is to produce the target surface with only one cut, while the whole flute length of the tool is used.

tips.title: Geodesic Machining Operation enables machining of complex 3D shapes
tips.body: InventorCAM’s Geodesic Machining operation enables machining of complex 3D Shapes with a tool path that has constant stepover and undercut areas.

tips.title: Screw Machining technology is used for parts with a variable pitch
tips.body: InventorCAM’s Screw Machining technology is used to create a tool path that is designed to mill parts/screws on a 4-Axis machine.

tips.title: Multiaxis Machining Operation creates tool paths for roughing pocket shaped geometries
tips.body: This operation creates a multiaxis tool path used to rough out pocket shaped geometries.

tips.title: Multiblade Machining Operation handles impellers and bladed disks
tips.body: This operation easily handles impellers and bladed disks, with multiple strategies to efficiently rough and finish each part of these complex shapes.

tips.title: Port Machining Operation provides both roughing and finishing tool paths
tips.body: This operation is an easy-to-use method for machining ports with tapered lollipop tools, and has collision checks for the entire tool.

tips.title: Edge Breaking Operation helps create deburring tool paths
tips.body: This operation helps create deburring tool paths on the outer edges of a part geometry.

tips.title: Edge Trimming Operation efficiently machines thin materials
tips.body: This operation is highly automated algorithm to create a tool path for the edge trimming of thin materials.

tips.title: 2D iMachining/3D iMachining generates optimized tool paths
tips.body: InventorCAM iMachining is an advanced technology of high speed machining that generates optimized tool paths.

tips.title: Define Coordinate System for Pocket Milling
tips.body: Choose MAC 1 (1-Position) as the Coordinate System.

tips.title: Select End Mill Tool for Pocket Operation
tips.body: Choose an End mill tool with a diameter of 8mm, arbor diameter of 10mm, total length of 80mm, outside holder length of 49mm, shoulder length of 45mm, shoulder angle of 90 degrees, and cutting length of 43mm.

tips.title: Set Machining Depth for Pocket Operation
tips.body: Define the pocket depth as -40mm with a step down value of 5mm.

tips.title: Configure Lead In and Lead Out for Pocket Operation

tips.body: Right-click the defined operation and choose Pocket from the Add Milling Operation submenu.

tips.title: Define geometry for pocket milling
tips.body: Select MAC 1 (2-Position), enable Smart Face, and select the face.

tips.title: Select tool for pocket milling
tips.body: Choose END MILL, mount to Milling [T6-T9]: T7, set Z value to 55.

tips.title: Define levels parameters for pocket milling
tips.body: Set values as shown in the image.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for pocket milling
tips.body: Select Climb direction, Linear adjacent passes connection.

tips.title: Define link parameters for pocket milling
tips.body: Set values as shown in the image.

tips.title: Calculate and simulate pocket milling operation
tips.body: Click Calculate, simulate in Host CAD mode.

tips.title: Define geometry for drilling operation
tips.body: Select MAC 1 (2-Position), ensure Multi-positions and All circles selected.

tips.title: Select tool for drilling operation
tips.body: Choose DRILL, mount to Milling [T6-T9]: T6, set Z value.

tips.title: Define levels parameters for drilling operation
tips.body: Set values as shown in the image.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for drilling operation
tips.body: Select Default sorting, Use cycle.

tips.title: Calculate and simulate drilling operation
tips.body: Click Calculate, simulate in Host CAD mode.

tips.title: Define geometry for tapping operation
tips.body: Select MAC 1 (2-Position), ensure Multi-positions and All circles selected.

tips.title: Select tool for tapping operation
tips.body: Choose TAP, mount to Milling [T6-T9]: T31, set Z value.

tips.title: Define levels parameters for tapping operation
tips.body: Set values as shown in the image.

tips.title: Calculate and simulate tapping operation
tips.body: Click Calculate, simulate in Host CAD mode.

tips.title: Define geometry for pocket milling on boss face
tips.body: Select MAC 1 (3-Position), enable Smart Face, and select the contour.

tips.title: Select tool for boss face milling
tips.body: Choose END MILL, select the tool with BI->MS [T17-T -19]: T18-A.

tips.title: Define levels parameters for boss face milling
tips.body: Set values as shown in the image.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for boss face milling
tips.body: Select Climb direction, Linear adjacent passes connection.

tips.title: Define link parameters for boss face milling
tips.body: Set values as shown in the image.

tips.title: Calculate and simulate boss face milling operation
tips.body: Click Calculate, simulate in Host CAD mode.

tips.title: Define geometry for pocket milling on middle pad
tips.body: Select MAC 1 (4-Position), enable Smart Face, and select the contour.

tips.title: Select tool for middle pad milling
tips.body: Choose END MILL, select the tool with BI->MS [T17-T -19]: T18-A.

tips.title: Define levels parameters for middle pad milling
tips.body: Set values as shown in the image.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for middle pad milling
tips.body: Select Climb direction, Linear adjacent passes connection.

tips.title: Define link parameters for middle pad milling
tips.body: Set values as shown in the image.

tips.title: Calculate and simulate middle pad milling operation
tips.body: Click Calculate, simulate in Host CAD mode.

tips.title: Define geometry for simultaneous 5-axis milling
tips.body: Select MAC 1 (1-Position), select drive surface and edge curve.

tips.title: Select tool for simultaneous 5-axis milling
tips.body: Choose END MILL, select the tool with BI->MS [T17-T -19]: T18-A.

tips.title: Define levels parameters for simultaneous 5-axis milling
tips.body: Set values as shown in the image.

tips.title: Define tool path parameters for simultaneous 5-axis milling
tips.body: Set Maximum step over value, use Approximate calculation.

tips.title: Calculate and simulate simultaneous 5-axis milling operation
tips.body: Click Calculate, simulate in Host CAD mode.

tips.title: Define tool axis control parameters
tips.body: Set Side tilt definition to Orthogonal to cut direction at each position.

tips.title: Define link parameters for drilling operation
tips.body: Use Lead-In and Use Lead Out in the First entry and Last exit lists.

tips.title: Define levels parameters for profile operation
tips.body: Set values as shown in the image.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for profile operation
tips.body: Set parameters as shown in the image.

tips.title: Define motion control parameters for profile operation
tips.body: Set values as shown in the image.

tips.title: Define tool for cutoff operation
tips.body: Select Ext. Grooving tool with T1, X=125, Y=20, Z=-0.645, Rx=180.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for cutoff operation
tips.body: Set parameters as shown in the image.

tips.title: Define link parameters for cutoff operation
tips.body: Set values as shown in the image.

tips.title: Define tool for face turning operation on back spindle
tips.body: Select Ext. Turning tool with Mount to Back Tools [T21-T28]: T21.

tips.title: Select STL holder for tool
tips.body: Use a new STL holder and import it from the STL Holders folder.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for face turning
tips.body: Set values and parameters on the Technology page of the Face Turning Operation dialog box.

tips.title: Define link parameters for face turning
tips.body: Set values and parameters on the Link page of the Face Turning Operation dialog box.

tips.title: Calculate and simulate face turning operation
tips.body: Click the Calculate button to calculate the tool path and simulate in Turning and SolidVerify mode.

tips.title: Define geometry for external turning on back spindle
tips.body: Select MAC 2 (1-Position) and define the contour on the Geometry page of the Turning Operation dialog box.

tips.title: Define tool for external turning on back spindle
tips.body: Select the same Ext. Turning tool used in earlier face turning operation.

tips.title: Define technological parameters for external turning
tips.body: Select Long external on the Technology tab and set work type to Rough, ISO-Turning method, and Entire geometry.

tips.title: Define link parameters for external turning
tips.body: Set values and parameters on the Link page of the Turning Operation dialog box.

tips.title: Calculate and simulate external turning operation
tips.body: Click the Calculate button to calculate the tool path and simulate in Turning and SolidVerify mode.

tips.title: Add MCO for part release
tips.body: Right-click the defined MCO and choose Add Machine Control Operation, selecting Back Spindle - Part Release.

tips.title: Simulate part in SolidVerify mode
tips.body: Right-click Operations in CAM-Manager, switch to SolidVerify mode, and set simulation parameters.

tips.title: Set up operation sequence manager for multi-channel machine
tips.body: Right-click Setup in CAM-Manager, select Operation Sequence Manager to synchronize and organize operations.

tips.title: Add new workpiece for advanced operation sequence manager setup
tips.body: Right-click and Add New Workpiece to set up operations on both spindles simultaneously.
